procedures.heading: General information
steps: Engine control module (ECM) incorporates self-diagnosis function.
Malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) will illuminate if certain faults are recorded.
ECM operates in backup mode if sensors fail, to enable vehicle to be driven to workshop.

procedures.heading: Accessing
steps: Trouble codes can be displayed by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC) 1.

procedures.heading: Erasing – except 2004 LS430/SC430
steps: After the faults have been rectified, trouble codes can be erased by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC) or as follows:
Ensure ignition switched OFF.
Disconnect battery ground cable for 60 seconds minimum.
Reconnect battery ground cable.

procedures.heading: Erasing – 2004 LS430/SC430
steps: Trouble codes can only be erased by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC).

Ignition switch ON – malfunction — Ignition switch, engine control relay, wiring
Ignition switch OFF – malfunction — Ignition switch, engine control relay, wiring
Key unlock warning switch – malfunction — Wiring, key unlock warning switch, engine control relay
Unrecognized key code — Key, incorrect key
Immobilizer system – no communication — Key, transponder, wiring, ECM
Communication malfunction 1 – interference — Incorrect key has been used, wiring, ignition module, ECM
Communication malfunction 2 — Key, transponder, ignition module, wiring, ECM
Immobilizer – malfunction — Wiring, immobilizer system, ECM
